entities.summary: Nikolay Pavlovich Abroskin is a Soviet and Russian military and government official, former Russian Army General (2003), and a candidate of technical sciences. He served as the Director of the Federal Agency for Special Construction (2004–2011) and the First Deputy Head of the Presidential Affairs Office of the Russian Federation (2015–2020).
